question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**on**" is used to indicate specific dates. (पर)
 
• In the context of the passage, **"on January 13, 2020"** correctly specifies the exact date when the orders were made.
 
• The other options:** "over," "at," and "in" **are not appropriate for indicating a specific date in this context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** The smog towers were installed by the Centre under the orders of the Supreme Court of India on__ January 13, 2020 and are being monitored by the Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, the DPCC said.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Over (पर)**: typically used to indicate movement or position above something.
 
• **At (में)**: used to indicate a specific point or location.
 
• **In (में)**: used to indicate a larger period or place.
